title: Special Mandatory District Plan Element Requirements
previewText: For buildings which are developed or enlarged within the East Midtown Subdistrict, the applicable provisions of Section 81-40 (MANDATORY DISTRICT PLAN ELEMENTS) shall be modified in accordance with the provisions of this Section, inclusive.
